title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Clark on Detroit Course
items.text: Wyndham Clark called the Detroit Golf Club redesign one of the best renovations he's seen but is sad the PGA Tour leads't return there next year.

items.headline: Georgia Hall's Comeback
items.text: Georgia Hall returned to compete 12 weeks post-birth despite knee issues and muscle loss, aiming to prove mothers can keep improving in golf.
